title: capesR
text: capesR package developed facilitate access manipulation data Catalog Theses Dissertations Brazilian Coordination Improvement Higher Education Personnel (CAPES). catalog includes information theses dissertations defended higher education institutions Brazil, variables : institution: Higher Education Institution. area: Academic field work. region state: Location research conducted. abstract: Brief description topic objectives. package automates process obtaining organizing data, making easily accessible analysis reporting. original CAPES data available dadosabertos.capes.gov.br. yearly Parquet files used package hosted Hugging Face. file index, URLs checksums, shipped package capes_years.

title: capesR
text: install package, use:
code: install.packages("capesR") # or the development version: devtools::install_github("milkway/capesR")

title: capesR
text: download_capes_data function downloads yearly CAPES data files. can specify desired years, corresponding files saved locally. use mirror, set options(capesR.base_url = "https://.mirror/path") pass base_url = directly.

title: capesR
text: Download data using temporary directory (function default): case, data persist future uses.
code: library(capesR) library(dplyr)  # Download data for 1987 and 1990 capes_files <- download_capes_data(c(1987, 1990))  # View the list of downloaded files capes_files %>% glimpse()

title: capesR
text: recommended define persistent directory store downloaded data instead using default temporary directory (tempdir()). allow reuse data future. using persistent directory, data downloaded . future uses, function identify files already exist directory return paths.
code: # Define the directory to store the data data_directory <- "/capes_data"  # Download data for 1987 and 1990 using a persistent directory capes_files <- download_capes_data(   c(1987, 1990),   destination = data_directory)

title: capesR
text: Use read_capes_data function combine downloaded files list generated download_capes_data function manually created.

code: # Combine all selected data without using filters combined_data <- read_capes_data(capes_files)  # View the combined data combined_data %>% glimpse()

title: capesR 0.2.0
text: Data updated CAPES open data portal: years 2023 2024 added, 2019, 2021 2022 replaced revised files CAPES published 2025 (institution names files now use (CAMPUS) instead ( CAMPUS )). package now covers 1987 2024. André Leite now package maintainer (previously Hugo Vasconcelos Medeiros). Data hosting moved OSF. yearly Parquet files now listed new capes_years dataset (year, file, url, bytes, md5), replaces years_osf. download_capes_data() reads URL table, host can change without touching code. download_capes_data() gains base_url argument (default getOption("capesR.base_url")) download mirror, downloads temporary .part file first, checks file size, warns requested years available. read_capes_data() text search now works actual column names data (titulo, resumo); previously recognised title, filters = list(titulo = "...") silently matched nothing. read_capes_data() longer loads whole dataset memory just read column names. Repository moved https://github.com/milkway/capesR.
